import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(I):
    out=[r[:] for r in I]; H=len(out); W=len(out[0])
    for i in range(H):
        start=None
        for j,c in enumerate(I[i]):
            if c==6: start=j; break
        if start is None: continue
        # fill 2,6 alternating starting after each 6, stop if next cell breaks pattern (not 5 or not matching alternation)
        j=start+1
        while j<W:
            kk=j-start-1
            if kk%2==0 and I[i][j]!=2: break
            if kk%2==1 and I[i][j]!=5: break
            out[i][j]= 2 if kk%2==0 else 6
            j+=1
    return out
